definitions.explanation: The physiological process of producing sweat. Used in medical, health, and scientific contexts more often than the everyday word {汗|あせ}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{発汗|はっかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{発汗|はっかん}⟦{作用|さよう}→作用：05761_sayou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was prescribed medicine with a diaphoretic effect.

examples.japanese: ⟦サウナ→サウナ：10935_sauna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{発汗|はっかん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すっきり→すっきり：05180_sukkiri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When you go into a sauna, you sweat a lot and your body feels refreshed.

notes:
{発汗|はっかん} combines ⟦{発|はつ}→〜発：04026_hatsu⟧ (emit, produce) + {汗|かん} (sweat). A technical term for the physiological process of sweating.

REGISTER:
Formal/technical. In everyday conversation, ⟦{汗|あせ}をかく→汗をかく：16925_asewokaku⟧ (to sweat) is far more common. {発汗|はっかん} appears mainly in medical, health, and sports science contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発汗|はっかん}⟦{作用|さよう}→作用：05761_sayou⟧: diaphoretic/sweat-inducing effect
- {発汗|はっかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{促|うなが}す→促す：10875_unagasu⟧: to promote sweating
- ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発汗|はっかん}: profuse sweating
- {発汗|はっかん}{量|りょう}: amount of perspiration

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧: sweat (everyday word)
- ⟦{汗|あせ}をかく→汗をかく：16925_asewokaku⟧: to sweat (everyday expression)
- {多汗症|たかんしょう}: hyperhidrosis (excessive sweating)
- ⟦{制汗剤|せいかんざい}→制汗剤：19170_seikanzai⟧: antiperspirant
